description: A shell script for testing the 'git hash-object' command. It sets up a repository, performs various hash-object operations, and verifies expected behavior and edge cases.

methods.name: echo_without_newline
methods.description: Prints arguments without a trailing newline.

methods.name: test_blob_does_not_exist
methods.description: Verifies that a blob does not exist in the Git database.

methods.name: test_blob_exists
methods.description: Verifies that a blob exists in the Git database.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes and sets up test files in a new repository.

methods.name: push_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository and sets it as the current working directory.

methods.name: pop_repo
methods.description: Removes the test repository and returns to the previous directory.
